meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并编辑带格式的Word文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作或修改格式复杂的Word文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently produce or modify Word documents with complex formatting.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能创建、读取、编辑 .docx/.dotx 文档:用 docx 库新建,改 XML 编辑,用 pandoc 读取,并支持修订、批注和 PDF 渲染校对。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、读取、编辑或处理 Word 文档(.docx/.dotx),或提到报告、信函、模板等时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 Word 文档,带目录和一级标题。
say.note: 生成的文档会含目录和分级标题。

say.text: 把这份 .docx 里所有“旧公司”改成“新公司”。
say.note: 会编辑 XML 并校验文档。

say.text: 给这段文字加一条批注。
say.note: 会添加批注并插入定位标记。

howto.what_en: Claude can create, read, edit, and manipulate .docx/.dotx documents: it writes docx-js scripts for new files, unzips and edits XML for existing ones, reads via pandoc, and supports tracked changes, comments, and PDF-based visual verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Word documents, .docx/.dotx files, or asks for reports, memos, letters, templates, or requests to create/read/edit/manipulate Word files.

say_en.text: Create a new Word document with a table of contents and headings.
Replace all “old company” with “new company” in this .docx.
say_en.note: Edits the XML and validates the file.

say_en.text: Add a comment to this paragraph.
say_en.note: Adds a comment and anchors it to the text.
